clue.text: Measure Fahrenheit in short

indicators.note: short tells us to clip the last letter off the phrase for in

parts.note: in, as in staying in, means at home

explanation.surface: Someone asks for a temperature reading in Fahrenheit, abbreviated.
explanation.walkthrough: 'short' cuts the last letter from AT HOME, leaving ATHOM.
explanation.definitionFit: To fathom something is to measure its depth, originally with a sounding line.

clue.text: Loud mouth's opening suggestion mostly shows adverse aspect

parts.note: F, forte, is the musical direction for loud
the lips frame the opening of the mouth

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the suggestion word is dropped

parts.note: an idea is a suggestion or proposal

explanation.surface: A loudmouth's first proposal mainly shows the downside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' trims IDEA to IDE; 'shows' links the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The other side of a matter, especially its less pleasant one, is an adverse aspect.

clue.text: Mad Hatter, not quite a Homeric character

indicators.note: Mad tells us the letters are crazily rearranged
not quite means the word falls one letter short of complete

explanation.surface: The Mad Hatter from Alice is almost a figure from Homer's epics.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not quite' drops the final R of HATTER, and 'Mad' rearranges HATTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A Greek letter is a character of the alphabet in which Homer wrote, hence Homeric.

clue.text: Oddly lacking hot air that propels floating craft

indicators.note: oddly lacking says the odd-numbered letters are removed, leaving the even ones

explanation.surface: Without hot air, something else must drive a balloon-like floating craft.
explanation.definitionFit: A rowing blade is the thing that pushes a boat through water.

clue.text: Witness is more confident accepting pardon

indicators.note: accepting means the word for more confident takes the other piece inside it

parts.note: bolder means braver, more sure of oneself
Eh? and Pardon? are both ways of asking someone to repeat themselves

explanation.surface: A witness grows in confidence after being granted a pardon.
explanation.definitionFit: A beholder is an onlooker, someone who sees an event, so a witness.

clue.text: Stare at what happens when someone saddens me audibly?

indicators.note: audibly signals that the phrase is to be heard, matched by sound

parts.words: what happens when someone saddens me
parts.note: when I am made sad I cry loudly, I bawl

explanation.surface: Glaring at someone who makes you cry.
explanation.definitionFit: To eyeball someone is to look hard at them, to stare at them.

clue.text: Change the score with art?

indicators.note: Change tells us to reorder the letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: Arranging a musical score with artistry.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: rearranging music for instruments is exactly what the answer means.
explanation.definitionFit: To arrange a score for an orchestra is to change it artfully into parts for many instruments.

clue.text: Start to diet and cut food intake to keep hearts living forever

indicators.note: start to points to the first letter of diet
to keep means the phrase for eating less holds the card suit inside

parts.note: to cut food intake is to eat less
H is the abbreviation for hearts in card games

explanation.surface: Dieting advice to protect the heart and live forever.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to keep' puts H, the cards abbreviation for hearts, inside the phrase for cutting food intake; the surface reads as heart-health advice.
explanation.definitionFit: Deathless means immortal, never dying, so living forever.

clue.text: Man consumed by sport I declare unhealthily wet

indicators.note: consumed by means the man is swallowed inside the sport

parts.note: RU is rugby union
he is a man, the male pronoun
My! is an exclamation like I declare!

explanation.surface: A man eaten up by sport declares himself feeling soggy and unwell.
explanation.walkthrough: 'consumed by' puts HE inside RU, the abbreviation for rugby union.
explanation.definitionFit: Rheumy describes eyes watering with mucus, an unhealthy wetness.

clue.text: Virginia is unable to be thoughtless

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
can't means is unable to

explanation.surface: A Virginian has no capacity for thought.
explanation.definitionFit: A vacant expression is blank and empty of thought.

clue.text: Pickled tea I brewed with brine

indicators.note: brewed suggests the letters are stewed together into a new mix

explanation.surface: Tea mixed with brine sounds like a nasty pickle.
explanation.definitionFit: Pickled is slang for drunk, and inebriate as an adjective means drunk.

clue.text: Stop cold and relax

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold, as on a tap
to ease is to relax or slacken

explanation.surface: Advice to someone overheating: stop, cool down and relax.
explanation.definitionFit: To cease is to come to a halt, a straight synonym of stop.

clue.text: Stone Age Homo sapiens, generation 6

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for stone, the British weight
taken as written
Homo sapiens is the scientific name for man
a generation is an age, a period of time

explanation.surface: A list of human prehistory from the Stone Age to modern man.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is the cross-reference '6', meaning the answer to 6 down, ORCHESTRATE, in its sense of arranging behind the scenes.
explanation.definitionFit: To orchestrate events is to arrange them carefully behind the scenes, as a theatre's organiser does.

clue.text: I'm expected to make a killing, maybe by applying cuts in final sentence

definitions.text: I'm expected to make a killing, maybe by applying cuts in final sentence

parts.words: I'm expected to make a killing, maybe by applying cuts in final sentence
parts.note: reads like a business tycoon cutting costs for profit, but describes the official who carries out a death sentence, perhaps with an axe

explanation.surface: A businessman expects to make a killing by cutting costs at the last minute.
explanation.definitionFit: This official carries out capital punishment, the final sentence, sometimes by beheading.

clue.text: Histrionic player under 28

definitions.meaning: 28 down is a joint at the top of the leg; the cut of meat from the thigh just below it shares this name

explanation.surface: An overdramatic actor, still under the age of 28.
explanation.walkthrough: 28 is 28 down, HIP; the second definition is the thigh and buttock area below it.
explanation.definitionFit: An overacting performer is a ham, and the ham is the back of the thigh, below the hip.

clue.text: Push in, holding Escape key on computer going down

indicators.note: holding means the word for push in has the other piece inside it

parts.note: to dent something is to push it in
Esc is the label on a computer keyboard's Escape key

explanation.surface: Instructions for jabbing the Escape key on a computer that is crashing.
explanation.definitionFit: A descent is a downward movement, so going down describes it as a noun phrase.

clue.text: Volunteers died, abyssal oceans overturning fast vessel

indicators.note: overturning means the whole string of pieces is read backwards

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
ob., from obiit, is the abbreviation for died
the deeps are the deepest parts of the oceans

explanation.surface: Volunteers drown when their boat capsizes in the deep ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: A powerboat built for high speed is a fast vessel.

clue.text: German theologian's article going into temptation briefly

definitions.note: the 's stands for is, joining the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: going into means the article is put inside the shortened word
briefly means the word for temptation loses its final letter

parts.note: a lure is a temptation or enticement
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A religious scholar's essay explores the subject of temptation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'briefly' drops the last letter of the temptation word, and 'going into' places the article inside what remains; the 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: Martin Luther was the German theologian who began the Protestant Reformation.

clue.text: Church avoids opportunities to test lineage

indicators.note: avoids means the church abbreviation is left out of the word

parts.note: chances are opportunities
to try is to test

explanation.surface: The Church shies away from chances to check family trees.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoids' removes CH from CHANCES, leaving ANCES.
explanation.definitionFit: Ancestry is one's line of descent, a straight synonym of lineage.

clue.text: Petrifying woman taking Continental water to America

parts.note: the Med, the Mediterranean, is the sea of continental Europe
USA is America, the United States

explanation.surface: A frightening woman carries water from Europe to the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth the Gorgon whose gaze turned onlookers to stone is the archetypal petrifying woman.

clue.text: Occasionally employed by paper

definitions.meaning: now and then, on some occasions
working at The Times, the newspaper that printed this puzzle

explanation.surface: Someone does only occasional work for a newspaper.
explanation.definitionFit: Now and then is the plain meaning, and working on The Times is the punning one.

clue.text: Hollywood actress makes a breezy stage entrance, perhaps

definitions.text: makes a breezy stage entrance, perhaps
definitions.meaning: to swan is to move in a casual, showy way, so a performer could be said to swan on to the stage

explanation.surface: A Hollywood star sweeps on to the stage with careless ease.
explanation.definitionFit: Gloria Swanson was a leading Hollywood actress of the silent era and of Sunset Boulevard.

clue.text: Dark boil possibly lanced by doctor

indicators.note: lanced by means the doctor pierces the sore and sits inside it

parts.note: a boil is one example of a sore
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A gloomy picture of a doctor lancing a boil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lanced by' places the doctor's letters inside the word for a boil, as a lancet pierces one.
explanation.definitionFit: Sombre means dark in colour or gloomy in mood.

clue.text: Linen, something related to light sleep?

parts.note: a nap is a short light sleep
kin are relatives, things related

explanation.surface: Bed linen as a relative of a light snooze.
explanation.definitionFit: Table linen includes the cloths diners use, so a napkin is a piece of linen.

clue.text: Tot's problem for hyperactive children

definitions.meaning: to tot up is to ... numbers together
attention deficit disorder, the condition diagnosed in restless, inattentive children

explanation.surface: A toddler's difficulty is one shared by hyperactive children.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's is 'is', linking the two definitions; 'Tot' is the verb, not a small child.
explanation.definitionFit: Tot up means total, and the initials are also those of attention deficit disorder.

clue.text: During fill-in period they're extremely wild

parts.note: in can mean during, as in in the night
a temp is a temporary worker who fills in
an era is a period of history

indicators.note: extremely points to the outside letters of they're

explanation.surface: Stand-in workers turn unruly while they are covering.
explanation.definitionFit: Intemperate means lacking self-control, so unrestrained or wild.

clue.text: An extensive 11 at sea

definitions.note: 11 is the answer to 11 across, a word for stop, so this asks for the sailor's word for stop

parts.note: vast means huge, extensive

explanation.surface: A sea of enormous size is described with a cross-reference.
explanation.walkthrough: 11 refers to 11 across, CEASE; the definition is a sailor's order to stop.
explanation.definitionFit: Avast is the nautical command to stop or hold, so it is the seafaring way to say stop.

clue.text: Part of Lucknow not recognised

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A traveller declares one district of the Indian city unfamiliar.
explanation.definitionFit: Something recognised is acknowledged or familiar, which is what being well known means.

clue.text: Parade in previous tax year?

definitions.meaning: a ceremonial procession of troops past a saluting point
the British tax year starts in April, so a month gone by just before it falls in the year before

explanation.surface: A procession is held in the last financial year.
explanation.walkthrough: The British tax year begins on 6 April, so last March belongs to the previous tax year.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal procession of troops past a reviewing officer is called by this name.

clue.text: Swinging joint

definitions.meaning: fashionable and lively, as in the swinging sixties
the ball-and-socket joint at the top of the leg

explanation.definitionFit: Hip is slang for fashionable or trendy, and also the joint between pelvis and thigh.

clue.text: Rain must spoil this outdoor pursuit

indicators.note: spoil suggests the words are wrecked and rebuilt in a different order

explanation.surface: Bad weather ruins a pastime enjoyed outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Nudism, being unclothed in the open air, is a pastime pursued outdoors and easily ruined by rain.

clue.text: Inflamed swelling covering belly with acne

indicators.note: covering means the swelling goes round the belly

parts.note: a sty or stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid
a pot is a pot belly

explanation.surface: A red swelling across a stomach blemished by acne.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with acne has a pimply, blemished complexion.
